claims.claim: Old rectangular black tempered glass center table.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows a rectangular glass-top with black frame/edges and decorative printed design, but does not confirm it is tempered glass or a 'center table' with legs.

claims.claim: Legs for standing the tape are not included.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show legs/stand or confirm their absence; it only notes corner brackets/fasteners and reflective side surfaces.

risks.risk: Glass may be cracked/chipped or have edge damage not visible in the single angle; this can make it unsafe and hard to use.
risks.proof: A close-up video of all four edges and all corners (slow pan) plus a shot showing the glass under strong light for cracks/chips.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a glass panel/table-top only, with potential damage risk (assume not guaranteed intact).

risks.risk: Tempered/safety glass status is unknown; if it’s not tempered, it affects safety and resale value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any marking/label on the glass (e.g., 'tempered' stamp) or a receipt/spec sheet; alternatively a close-up of the edge where markings usually appear.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-verified tempered glass (treat as standard glass-top).

risks.risk: Stability/assembly is unknown: corner brackets may be loose, frame may be warped, or hardware may be missing.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the frame being gently pushed/tilted to demonstrate wobble, and a photo of all corner brackets/fasteners with screws/hardware visible.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially incomplete/needs rework (assume hardware/fit not guaranteed).

risks.risk: Dimensions and whether it includes legs/stand are unknown; buyer may need extra parts to make it usable.
risks.proof: A tape-measure photo showing length, width, and height (or thickness) and a photo confirming whether legs/stand are included.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a top/panel without legs (worst-case usability).

risks.risk: Surface condition (scratches, scuffs, print wear) is unclear; decorative print may be faded or scratched.
risks.proof: Macro close-ups of the printed area and glass surface from multiple angles under light, showing scratches/etching and print clarity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with possible visible wear (assume scratches/scuffs).

proof_requests: Provide exact dimensions (L/W and height or thickness) with a tape measure in-frame.
Show whether legs/stand are included: clear photos of the underside and any mounting points.
Send close-up photos/videos of all four corners and all edges to confirm no chips/cracks.
Show any 'tempered' marking/stamp on the glass edge or a spec/receipt.
Provide macro shots of the printed design and glass surface under bright light to assess scratches/print wear.
response.reason: The witness can identify a decorative black-framed glass top/panel, but key pricing drivers are unverified (tempered status, intactness, and whether legs/stand are included). Without those proof shots, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
